note: THE DEPOSIT WAS THE THIRD MOUTH OF judge_survey AND NOBODY COUNTED IT FOR EIGHTEEN DAYS. The berth door keeps a flat address rule on purpose; the promotion sieve disposes through the successor order on the stated ground that it 'alone stands downstream of a move'. It does not — deposit_survey runs on the far side of the build the packet was charted for, and it was re-running the door's flat rule. It now runs validate_survey_at_deposit, which is the door plus exactly one tolerance: the holdings-resolve ADDRESS finding, filtered through the ONE successor body via a new public name resolves_to that delegates rather than restating the precedence. MEASURED, 57 berths: 45 carried a moved address, 352 findings disposed, 3 still refused. WHAT THE VOYAGE GOT WRONG, AND IT IS THE SAME SHAPE THREE TIMES: a number written from a model of a mechanism instead of from the mechanism. The pre-build sweep modelled judge_survey and not the door's full shape record, so hypothesis 1 and criteria 3 and 4 all said 43-and-2 where the built path says 42-and-3 — hypothesis 1 is KILLED by its own falsifier clause and the criteria were restated as INVARIANTS and re-berthed. Criterion 6 asked for a trail_link, a field retired on 2026-08-16 when the hash chain went; restated against the 0444 mode bit, the exact eight-field set, and standing()'s fingerprint. And the probe's first draft read the wire broken while it was fine, because it borrowed a template berth by SHAPE and got one the door refuses for an unrelated 2026-08-03 identity rule — the template is chosen by the door now. THIS CROSSING ALSO ADDED gated_by:['CC'] TO THE SURVEY CHARTER, because the clearance gate refused without it: the owner was prose, and prose cannot gate. CENSUS TAKEN RATHER THAN THE INSTANCE FIXED ALONE — 27 of 39 beside-code charters carry no gated_by, including four of the seven chart stages and verdict, so every one of them is a boat that cannot enter proven-space today. A ticket is owed; widening the fix here would be outside this voyage's bounds. THE THIRD STILL-REFUSED BERTH IS THE NEXT TICKET, not a defect here: survey-20260728T170650 is held by a request-identity rule added 2026-08-03 that retro-reds a 2026-07-28 packet. That is a deposit standing downstream of a change to the RULES rather than to the WORLD — the sibling of this finding, named in the validate berth's unknowns and owed a cast.
